title: Bar Avuha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 53b: Abaye recites the blessing (over the lights of the fire) at the house of Bar Abuha. The reading in Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin is “Bar Chavu,” which Hyman regards as the correct reading.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The preference for Bar Chavu is Hyman’s textual judgment.

The returned Berakhot 53b reads that Abaye blesses at the house of bar Avuh. Hyman’s preference for Bar Chavu and his reports of Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin are preserved as his textual judgment, not a new apparatus collation.
